claims.text: Dermatome: the body area supplied by one spinal nerve's sensory and motor fibers.
claims.quote: Dermatome: each spinal n.’s sensory & motor fibers supply info to specific body distribution

claims.text: 31 pairs of spinal nerves leave the cord, each through an intervertebral foramen.
claims.quote: Spinal Cord: 31 spinal n. Pairs pairs arise from spinal cord which exit @ach intervertebral foramen

claims.text: The cord ends at L1; lumbar puncture is done at L3-L5.
claims.quote: Spinal cord ends @ L1 -> lumbar puncture: L3-L5

claims.text: Lateral spinothalamic tract (ascending): light and crude touch, pressure, temperature and pain.
claims.quote: Lateral: spinothalmic & spinocerebellar tract function: mediate sensations - facilitate signals: complex discrimination - transmit precise info: stim type & location Sensation of: light & crude touch, P, temp, pain

claims.text: Dorsal columns (fasciculus gracilis and cuneatus): fine touch, two-point discrimination and proprioception.
claims.quote: Dorsal column tract (fasciculus gracilis + fasciculus cuneatus) Sensations: fine touch, two point-discrimination, & proprioception

claims.text: Corticospinal tract (descending): skilled, delicate, purposeful movement.
Decussation: the descending corticospinal tracts cross to the opposite side in the medulla.
claims.quote: medulla oblongata descending corticospinal tracts decussate (cross to contralat side)

claims.text: Bilateral sensory loss below a dermatome level points to spinal cord injury or compression.
claims.quote: Spinal cord level: B/L loss below dermatome level; spinal cord injury or compression

claims.text: Unilateral dorsal column loss points to an ipsilateral dorsal column lesion (Brown-Séquard syndrome).
claims.quote: Unilateral loss: Ipsilat dorsal column lesion (Brown-Séquard syndrome).
